verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a company-incorporation and notarization platform, so registered-agent and digital-mail services are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers incorporation, notarization, translation, apostilles and post-formation filings (tax, trade, transparency register). None of it shows the platform acting as a registered agent, offering a business address, or scanning legal mail and service of process.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the platform as my registered agent and receive scanned legal mail and service of process digitally
